summary: Make reliability and guided operator usability explicit acceptance requirements for planned host-loss recovery. API impact: none; planning clarification only.

guide.reason: Recovery is not implemented. The plan strengthens future guide and first-time-operator walkthrough requirements without inventing available controls.

api.reason: No runtime callers or contracts change. Planned readiness, preflight and progress observations remain Core-owned and use the recovery contract work already required in this section.

roadmap.reason: Refines acceptance criteria for the manual recovery and rehearsal items already listed as outstanding on the roadmap; no milestone, status or separate capability is added.

state.reason: Documentation only; no durable state added. Planned readiness and recovery-operation results remain Core-owned rather than Controller-derived.

verification.method: Review the added criteria against the existing recovery safety/API boundaries and planned-only status; run documentation, privacy and whitespace checks. Recovery fault injection and first-time-operator tests remain future acceptance work, not executed results.
